description:
Define the new bridge from first principles as trusted Vrooli-to-Vrooli collaboration between machines.

The specification should cover:
- node identity and trust establishment
- permission and capability model
- request-response versus long-running task/session behavior
- observability and debugging expectations
- failure handling and reconnection
- the first concrete use case: remote validation and emulator transport
- how the bridge remains general enough for future trusted cross-server collaboration beyond validation
name: greenfield-vrooli-bridge-foundation-spec
title: Define The Greenfield Bridge From First Principles
